# Licenses of the code bundled in or-calendar.min.js

`src/calendar/or-calendar.min.js` (the calendar layer the TV, the landing page and the
Shabbat sheet load) bundles these open source packages, unmodified, with the Or Hachaim
calendar code. Their licenses are the files in this folder; names, versions and upstream
source repositories are in `../packages.json`.

| Package | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| @hebcal/core | 6.14.7 | GPL-2.0-or-later | https://github.com/hebcal/hebcal-es6 |
| @hebcal/hdate | 0.23.1 | GPL-2.0-or-later | https://github.com/hebcal/hdate-js |
| @hebcal/leyning | 10.1.0 | BSD-2-Clause | https://github.com/hebcal/hebcal-leyning |
| @hebcal/noaa | 0.12.4 | LGPL-2.1 | https://github.com/hebcal/noaa |
| quick-lru | 7.3.0 | MIT | https://github.com/sindresorhus/quick-lru |
| temporal-polyfill | 1.0.6 | MIT | https://github.com/fullcalendar/temporal-polyfill |
| temporal-utils | 1.0.3 | MIT | https://github.com/fullcalendar/temporal-polyfill |

The same versions are published on npm (for example `npm pack @hebcal/core@6.14.7`).
